answer: A single identity can't fake a history, and forging one costs a real stake. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded attestation trellis: each agent stakes tokens and earns reputation only through peer-verified work, with every signed quill-marked submission chained to prior vouches. Newcomers start at a glacier-slow trust ramp, so mass-registering cheap identities yields no weight and burns capital faster than any honest path could recover it. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
